dialogues.speaker: Zhila
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm not blaming you. Please don't mind me.

dialogues.speaker: Zhila
dialogues.text: It's my own fault. My memory has been failing me lately. I either forget what I'm supposed to deliver, or forget what I'm supposed to sell...

dialogues.speaker: Zhila
dialogues.text: Luckily, the owner of this place has more important things to worry about than the insignificant work I'm in charge of.

dialogues.speaker: Zhila
dialogues.text: Well, enough of that, let me continue thinking. Where the heck did I put a long list like that?
